facts.fact: The National Registration Act [Chapter 10:17], an Act of Parliament commenced 24 September 1976, sets up the Registrar-General of National Registration, a register of residents and identity documents, and the consolidated text is stated as up to date as at 31 December 2016.

note: No cover fact: the text names fingerprints and a photograph but does not state a biometric register, a unique number or electronic checking.

facts.fact: Statutory Instrument 10 of 2024, gazetted 30 January 2024, was made by the Minister of Home Affairs and Cultural Heritage under section 11 of the National Registration Act [Chapter 10:17], showing the Act in force.

note: No cover fact: the instrument only changes fees, which is not an applying rule.

facts.fact: The National Registration Act [Chapter 10:17], an Act of Parliament commenced 24 September 1976, provides for registration of residents, a register kept by the Registrar-General and identity documents, in a ZimLII consolidation up to date as at 31 December 2016.

note: No cover fact: the text does not state a biometric register, a unique number or electronic checking.
